Online reviews of the site are poor with an average star rating at 1.4, with 85% 
of people rating it one star on (Trustpilot, 2024). Most of the reviews seem to 
claim that they used to enjoy the site, however they have become too “greedy”, 
locking many things behind a paywall. Despite these ratings, from a purely 
functional perspective, the reviews are generally positive.  
Quizlet seems to highly align with the spaced repetition educational framework, 
gamification strategies such as streaks and badges, and text can be read aloud, 
enabling better accessibility. However, questions seem to be limited to multiple 
choice, and there does not seem to be any actionable analytics. 
2.5.7 RemNote 
(Bjornstad, 2024) describes RemNote as a flash card creation and note taking 
application, with the aim of aiding students to better remember information. 
Students are supposed to create bullet pointed information known as “rems”, 
typically led with a question, followed by an answer. RemNote will automatically 
create flash cards from this information, and periodically question the student, 
following the spaced repetition framework. 
RemNote reviewed very well with 4.7 stars on (Product hunt, 2024), most 
people were highly satisfied with the flashcard functionality, and its ability to aid 
in information memorisation. Some users did not find the UI intuitive, however 
these reviews were typically older.
